items.title: The three big debates around music and generative AI
items.excerpt: Generative AI models that output music pose many questions for the industry; CMU organises them into three big debates ahead of an Un-Convention panel on music and AI.

items.title: Sony and Universal ask court to force Suno investor Lightspeed to testify about the 'legal risk of training data'
items.excerpt: In a Boston federal court filing on October 13, Sony and Universal opposed Suno investor Lightspeed's motion to quash their subpoena seeking testimony on the 'legal risk of training data'.

items.title: 90,000 synthetic tracks a day: Why Deezer is handing users the ultimate AI 'kill switch'
items.excerpt: An MBW explainer on why Deezer, citing around 90,000 synthetic tracks uploaded per day, is giving listeners a 'kill switch' to exclude AI-generated music.

items.title: Is The Humanity of Instruments Under Threat from AI?
items.excerpt: With a surge of vibe-coded instrument plugins flooding the market, Gearnews asks whether instrument design risks losing its most important feature - human character and intent.

items.title: New studies explore AI expectations, jobs impact and gender gap
items.excerpt: Music Ally rounds up several new studies on how AI will affect jobs, expectations and the gender gap in AI use - context beyond the AI-music debates for music-industry workers.

items.title: Deezer lets users hide AI music; Playhead generates signal chains for producers
items.excerpt: Alongside Deezer's option to fully exclude AI-generated music, Music Ally covers Playhead, an AI tool that generates plugin signal chains for producers.

items.title: Publishing body ICMP blasts potential AI rules in Australia
items.excerpt: Global publishing body ICMP criticised potential rules in Australia's developing AI, training and copyright policy, following labels body ARIA's select-committee testimony.

items.title: Artists Behind Olivia Rodrigo 'Expectations' Music Video Debunk AI Accusations
items.excerpt: Graphic designer Jack Harrison and Rodrigo's official fan account released behind-the-scenes footage of the 2D/3D animation and analog treatments to rebut claims the video was AI-generated.

items.title: A$AP Rocky Has a Very Diplomatic Stance on AI in Music: 'Who Am I to Say What's Standard'
items.excerpt: A$AP Rocky revealed his thoughts on the growing use of AI in music, taking a diplomatic line: 'Who am I to say what's standard.'

items.title: Olivia Rodrigo Clarifies AI Stance Following 'Invasive' Tech Investor Dating Rumors
items.excerpt: Olivia Rodrigo clarified her stance on AI and addressed rumors she was dating an AI tech investor.

items.title: Vibe coding is turning the music gear world upside down
items.excerpt: LLM coding assistants have triggered an explosion of user-built custom firmware and hacks for synths, samplers and grooveboxes, changing who gets to reshape music hardware.

items.title: Apple acquires AI startup that lets musicians rework recorded music
items.excerpt: Apple has acquired Samplab, a Swiss startup that described itself as offering 'music production for the age of AI' with tools that let musicians rework recorded music; AppleInsider frames the deal as a boost for Logic Pro.

items.title: From Individual Songs to Music Corpora: Evaluating Explainable Harmonic Decision-Making on HookTheory
items.excerpt: Researchers test whether an explainable harmonic decision model built for individual songs generalises to the HookTheory corpus, a step toward transparent automatic melody harmonization tools.

items.title: D-Composer: Language Modeling for Simultaneous Drum Transcription and Sound Event Decomposition
items.excerpt: D-Composer uses language modelling to transcribe drum beats while decomposing them into their constituent one-shot sound events, building on drum analysis-by-synthesis models.

items.title: MUB: An Identity-Masked Benchmark for Music Understanding in Multimodal Language Models
items.excerpt: MUB is a 500-track identity-masked benchmark that tests whether multimodal language models genuinely hear music rather than recovering answers from metadata or external tools.
